name: SPAN
description: SPAN is a cross-calendar temporal reasoning benchmark requiring large language models to perform intra-calendar temporal reasoning and inter-calendar temporal conversion across six calendars with multiple reasoning directions and question formats.
reputation: A very recent specialized benchmark for temporal reasoning and calendar conversion, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: Features dynamic instance generation for contamination-free evaluation and highlights challenges like Future-Date Degradation and Calendar Asymmetry Bias.
